analysisSummary: Mechanism verified in code (permissionless batch withdraw with incentive + permissionless depositToWarehouse), but it is the literal acknowledged exception to prior audit finding H-01. Program eligibility requires distinctness from audit-covered issues. NOT_A_BUG for filing purposes (duplicate of audit-covered, acknowledged behavior).
suggestedFix: None — acknowledged by the team; docs/UI warnings are the stated mitigation. A code fix would be to make PullSplit.depositToWarehouse owner-or-distribute-only, but that is the H-01 recommendation already considered.

analysisSummary: Reentrant distribute() is reachable via the full-gas distributor transfer, but independent trace of the balance accounting shows extraction is bounded by rounding dust plus 1-wei leftovers: fresh snapshots per call plus full-amount payout means any larger reentrant drain makes the outer transfer revert and unwinds everything. No attacker-attainable fund loss. Documented unwind behavior.
suggestedFix: None required. Defense-in-depth could add a reentrancy guard or pay the distributor reward via the warehouse fallback path, but no fund loss is demonstrated.

analysisSummary: Same accounting bound as HUNT-2, plus hook/fee-on-transfer tokens are outside the documented supported set. No attacker-attainable fund loss demonstrated; profitable reentrancy requires the victim share to fit inside dust. NOT_A_BUG.
suggestedFix: None required; document hook-token behavior alongside the existing token-compatibility notes if desired.

analysisSummary: Duplicate signer values would defeat the threshold, but introducing them requires owner/self authorization (factory config or onlySelf addSigner), and the owner is root by documented design. No attacker-reachable chain. Fails the privilege precondition (triage Q4). NOT_A_BUG as a vulnerability; owner-configuration footgun at most.
suggestedFix: Consider a duplicate-value check in initializeSigners/addSigner as hardening; not a bounty finding.

analysisSummary: Self-call upgrade path in ownerless vaults is real, but modules are fully trusted and can already drain all funds directly; the deployed modules cannot construct an upgrade call. No new attacker-attainable impact. NOT_A_BUG.
suggestedFix: None required; module trust is documented. Consider excluding upgradeToAndCall targets in executeFromModule as hardening if the trust model ever tightens.

analysisSummary: Mint-before-pull insolvency for fee-on-transfer tokens is real and explicitly documented as unsupported behavior with the exact consequence described. Fails triage Q5 (documented behavior). NOT_A_BUG.
suggestedFix: None — documented. A balance-delta deposit pattern would support FoT tokens but is out of scope for this finding.

analysisSummary: Permissionless sweep is the module's stated purpose, gated by owner-enabled module status; shares go to the account itself and are owner-redeemable. No theft, no freeze. NOT_A_BUG.
